LLM-Assisted Analysis

14/15 scenarios passed — scene_object_fixture regex mismatch

Provider: deepseek · Model: deepseek-chat · Generated On: 2026-07-04T16:28:24+00:00 · Stage: scenario · Confidence: high

The CI run for PR #121 (feat(memory): extend memory with causal knowledge graph model) passed 14 of 15 scenarios (93.3%). The sole failure is the `scene_object_fixture` scenario, which expects `list_objects` to return at least one non-robot object, but the scene only reports the robot itself. All other scenarios — including the new memgraph service, builtin file operations, camera/lidar snapshots, explore, mapping, memory roundtrip, speech, voiceprint, fault recovery, object navigation, and patrol observe — passed successfully.

PR Changes

  • Added new memgraph service (Scribe Mem) with remember, search, and compact MCP tools under `robonix/service/memgraph/`
  • Added new `robonix/service/memory/remember` contract and deprecated `robonix/service/memory/save` in favour of remember
  • Added new `robonix/service/memgraph/compact` contract and updated `robonix/service/memory/compact` to reference memgraph
  • Added new `robonix/service/memgraph/search` contract and updated `robonix/service/memory/search` to reference memgraph
  • Added new `robonix/service/memory/remember` contract definition
  • Added new `robonix/service/memgraph/remember` contract definition
  • Added new `robonix/service/memgraph/search` contract definition
  • Added new `robonix/service/memgraph/compact` contract definition
  • Added new `robonix/service/memory/remember` capability manifest
  • Added new `robonix/service/memgraph/remember`, `search`, `compact` capability manifests
  • Updated `examples/webots/robonix_manifest.yaml` to include the new memgraph service
  • Added full memgraph service implementation under `services/memory/` including core pipelines, storage backends, tests, and build scripts
  • Updated `uv.lock` to include `robonix-scribe-memory` workspace member and updated grpcio dependency
  • Updated docs subproject commit

Test Result

  • Webots CI ran 15 scenarios: 14 passed, 1 failed. The failed scenario `scene_object_fixture` called `robonix/system/scene/list_objects` 45 times; each response contained only the robot object (label "robot"), but the test regex `"label":\s*"(?!robot)[^"]+"` requires at least one non-robot object. All other scenarios (builtin file ops, camera/lidar snapshots, explore, mapping save, memory roundtrip, speech, voiceprint, fault recovery, object navigation, patrol observe) passed.

Likely Root Cause

  • The Webots simulation world likely contains only the robot and no other detectable objects (e.g., furniture, obstacles) that the scene perception system can register. The test expectation assumes at least one non-robot object will be present, but the default world may be empty or the perception pipeline may not have detected any objects within the test timeout.

Suggested Fix

  • Either add non-robot objects to the Webots simulation world (e.g., a table, chair, or cup) or relax the test regex to accept the robot-only case as valid (e.g., change regex to allow zero or more non-robot objects). The test should also consider that the scene may legitimately contain only the robot in a minimal environment.

Risks Or Watchouts

  • The new memgraph service was not exercised by any CI scenario — consider adding a dedicated scenario for memgraph remember/search/compact
  • The scene_object_fixture failure is a test expectation mismatch, not a code regression; it may indicate the simulation world is too sparse for the scene perception to detect objects
  • The voiceprint_list scenario returned 'db not initialised' — this is expected for a fresh environment but may mask a real initialization issue
